[package]
name = "bivvy"
version = "1.7.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.93"
description = "Interactive development environment setup automation"
license-file = "LICENSE"
repository = "https://github.com/bivvy-dev/bivvy"
keywords = ["cli", "setup", "development", "automation"]
categories = ["command-line-utilities", "development-tools"]

[dependencies]
# CLI framework
clap = { version = "4.5.56", features = ["derive", "env"] }

# Interactive prompts
dialoguer = "0.12.0"
console = "0.16.2"

# Progress indicators
indicatif = "0.18.3"

# Serialization
serde = { version = "1.0.228", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.149"

# YAML parsing
serde_yaml = "0.9"

# YAML with source location tracking (for lint error reporting)
marked-yaml = "0.8.0"

# Error handling
anyhow = "1.0.100"
thiserror = "2.0.18"

# File system
dirs = "6.0.0"
walkdir = "2.5.0"
glob = "0.3.3"

# Process execution
which = "8.0.0"

# HTTP client (for remote templates)
reqwest = { version = "0.13.1", default-features = false, features = ["blocking", "json", "rustls"] }

# Time handling (for state)
chrono = { version = "0.4.43", features = ["serde"] }

# Hashing (for project identification)
sha2 = "0.10"
hex = "0.4.3"

# Random number generation (for session IDs)
getrandom = "0.2"

# Regular expressions (for version extraction)
regex = "1"

# Logging
tracing = "0.1.44"
tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3.22", features = ["env-filter"] }

# Embed templates at compile time
include_dir = "0.7.4"
clap_complete = "4.5.65"

# URL handling (for feedback delivery)
open = "5"
urlencoding = "2"

[dev-dependencies]
assert_cmd = "2.1.2"
httpmock = "0.8"
predicates = "3.1.3"
tempfile = "3.24.0"

[target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies]
libc = "0.2"

[profile.release]
lto = true
strip = true
codegen-units = 1
opt-level = "z"

# Unify Error Handling: Replace `anyhow::Result` with `BivvyError` Across All Modules

## Context

The codebase has a well-designed `BivvyError` enum in `src/error.rs` with a `Result<T>` alias, but 17 source files bypass it by using `anyhow::Result` directly. This means errors from those modules lose domain specificity — they all collapse into `BivvyError::Other(anyhow::Error)` at module boundaries. Explicit `anyhow::bail!` and `anyhow::anyhow!` calls in 7 files construct generic errors that should be proper `BivvyError` variants.

## Step 1: Add new `BivvyError` variants (`src/error.rs`)

Add 4 new variants to handle error types that currently flow through `anyhow`:

```rust
/// JSON serialization/deserialization error.
#[error("JSON error: {0}")]
SerdeJson(#[from] serde_json::Error),

/// YAML serialization/deserialization error.
#[error("YAML error: {0}")]
SerdeYaml(#[from] serde_yaml::Error),

/// Network/HTTP fetch error.
#[error("Network error for {url}: {message}")]
NetworkError { url: String, message: String },

/// Git operation error.
#[error("Git error: {message}")]
GitError { message: String },
```

These cover the external error types that lack `From<T> for BivvyError` impls and would prevent switching from `anyhow::Result` to `crate::error::Result`.

## Step 2: Convert infrastructure modules (8 files)

These modules underpin the CLI commands. Switch each from `anyhow::Result` to `crate::error::Result`.

**`src/session/store.rs`** — Replace `anyhow::{Context, Result}` with `crate::error::Result`. IO errors auto-convert via `BivvyError::Io`, JSON errors via new `BivvyError::SerdeJson`. Replace `.context(...)` with `.map_err()` to appropriate variants.

**`src/feedback/store.rs`** — Same pattern as session/store.

**`src/cache/store.rs`** — Same pattern. JSON errors from serde auto-convert.

**`src/cache/validation.rs`** — Replace `anyhow::Result`. For `parse_ttl()`, convert `ParseIntError` via `.map_err(|e| BivvyError::ConfigValidationError { message: format!("Invalid TTL: {e}") })`.

**`src/cache/revalidation.rs`** — Replace `anyhow::Result`. Errors from fetchers and IO auto-convert.

**`src/config/env_file.rs`** — Replace `anyhow::Result`. Only IO errors, which auto-convert.

**`src/shell/resume.rs`** — Replace `anyhow::Result`. IO and serde_json errors auto-convert.

**`src/updates/version.rs`** — Replace `anyhow::{Context, Result}`. Convert `reqwest::Error` via `.map_err(|e| BivvyError::NetworkError { url, message: e.to_string() })`. Replace `.context(...)` similarly.

## Step 3: Convert fetch/network modules (4 files)

**`src/registry/fetch/http.rs`** — Replace `anyhow::{bail, Result}` with `crate::error::{BivvyError, Result}`. Convert all `bail!(...)` to `return Err(BivvyError::NetworkError { url: url.to_string(), message: ... })`. Convert `reqwest::Error` propagation with `.map_err()`.

**`src/registry/fetch/git.rs`** — Replace `anyhow::{bail, Result}` with `crate::error::{BivvyError, Result}`. Convert all `bail!(...)` to `return Err(BivvyError::GitError { message: ... })`.

**`src/registry/remote.rs`** — Replace `anyhow::{Context, Result}`. Convert `bail!(...)` for template parsing to `BivvyError::ConfigParseError`. Convert `.with_context()` to `.map_err()` with `BivvyError::NetworkError`.

**`src/config/remote.rs`** — Replace `anyhow::{anyhow, Context, Result}`. Convert `anyhow!(...)` to `BivvyError::NetworkError`. Convert `.with_context()` to `.map_err()`.

## Step 4: Convert config/extends module (1 file)

**`src/config/extends.rs`** — Replace `anyhow::{anyhow, Result}`. Convert:
- Depth exceeded → `BivvyError::ConfigValidationError`
- Circular extends → `BivvyError::CircularDependency`
- Empty/invalid URL → `BivvyError::ConfigValidationError`
- SSRF blocks → `BivvyError::ConfigValidationError`

## Step 5: Convert CLI/command modules (4 files)

- "No update command" → `BivvyError::CommandFailed`
- "Empty update command" → `BivvyError::CommandFailed`
- "Update command failed" → `BivvyError::CommandFailed`

**`src/feedback/delivery.rs`** — Replace `anyhow::anyhow!(...)` in `open_url()` with `BivvyError::ShellError`.

**`src/cli/commands/cache.rs`** — Replace `anyhow::Result` in internal fns (`list_cache`, `clear_cache`, `show_stats`) with `crate::error::Result`.

**`src/cli/commands/feedback.rs`** — Replace `anyhow::Result` in internal fns with `crate::error::Result`.

**`src/cli/session_wrapper.rs`** — Replace `anyhow::Result` with `crate::error::Result`.
